name: native-restore-memory
goal: Bound evidence restoration memory while preserving note selection and missing evidence checks

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The hosted macOS verifier exhausted its reserve. On restored real history, existing restore, trust and impact retained 2.48 GB RSS; a batched verification-note and streamed-record prototype retained 1.40 GB and selected the same records.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/repositories/explanation-notes-order.test.ts uses only two small note-bearing commits and does not exercise restoration with many large notes or corrupt entries. Extend that existing note fixture with realistic large Git notes, a cached verification and missing or mismatched evidence.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed note-history test c9265cf3 failed its bounded RSS assertion; record cfd4963e keeps the command, expected missing evidence and workload observation.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 8a0a0c3d reads verification notes in batches and scans cached record ids without retaining unrelated records.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged note-history test passed at 8a0a0c3d; green record 72e4f5b3 pairs with red 59d7b6af in the same environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
